title: Oral tumor N-glycans associated with lymph node metastasis
description: Relative abundances of 83 isomer-resolved N-glycan features from 31 oral squamous cell carcinoma tumors with or without lymph node metastasis.
details: The complete source matrix contains 12 N0 and 19 N+ tumor samples. Glycan isomers remain distinct and source MS/MS confirmation, retention time, core fucosylation, bisecting GlcNAc and sialic-acid diagnostics are retained. Eighty-two partial structures combine the source spectral atlas with explicit sialic-acid linkage information from Table S3; unnumbered linkages and unresolved arms remain unknown. Feature 9b has no MS/MS-confirmed topology and retains composition only. Analytes were reduced glycans; this preparation is recorded separately from monosaccharide identity.
table: Deposited Glycan_results.xlsx, TS3; published supplementary spectral atlas
annotation: Source spectral-atlas topologies with TS3-supported sialic linkages; unnumbered linkages and uncertain arms retained as unknown. Composition-only annotation for 9b.
